about: Churches whose title feast the name leaves open (Pavol 2026-10-30: show nothing; "Explore parish sites of the ambiguous ones to find the feast"). A row is confirmed only where the parish website, parish bulletin or diocese names the feast or saint for this church in text that was read; dates inferred from a Sunday alone, two poutě, search-summary quotes and municipal/tourist sources do not count; neither does a dedication statement without a feast or pouť day. Where a parish keeps two poutě, the row counts only if the source calls one of them the titular feast. Confirmed rows feed PARISH_TITLES in src/domain/patron.ts.
